description: This file declares the EnvVariableParser class responsible for parsing environment variables related to logging configuration in the Rialto project. It includes methods to retrieve logging levels, and check if console or file logging is enabled, along with private configuration methods and internal state variables.

classes.name: EnvVariableParser
classes.description: A class that manages parsing environment variables to configure logging levels, console logging, and file logging for the Rialto project.

methods.name: EnvVariableParser
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the EnvVariableParser object.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the debug level for a specific component.

methods.name: isConsoleLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if console logging is enabled.

methods.name: isFileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if file logging is enabled.

methods.name: configureRialtoDebug
methods.description: Configures the debug level settings based on environment variables.

methods.name: configureRialtoConsoleLog
methods.description: Configures console logging settings based on environment variables.

methods.name: configureFileLogging
methods.description: Configures file logging settings based on environment variables.
